KILN TRAIL
Approximately 1.65 miles (round-trip)
An abandoned limestone kiln can be found along this
trail. Rebuilt in 1977, the limestone kiln may have been
used for plaster because of its fine quality. Parking
available at the start of the trail.

HORSE TRAIL
Approximately 6.15 miles (no loops)
Approximately 9.25 (with loops)
Much of the different scenery White Mound County Park
offers can be found along the horse trails. For those who
bring their own horses, this trail includes 3 additional
loops for those looking for some extra mileage. There are
also 3 water crossings on the trail and is also open to
hikers. The south loop is approximately 0.6 miles and the
northern loops are both approximately 1.25 miles in
length. Trailer parking available at the horse camp-
ground.

LAKE TRAIL
Approximately 2.93 miles (full-loop)
The Lake Trail travels around White Mound Lake. It cross-
es the dam and a picturesque bridge - perfect for photo
ops! Parking available at the beach / office area, boat
landing or dam parking lot.

WILLIE WALSH NATURE TRAIL
Approximately .25 miles (one-way)
The Willie Walsh Nature Trail is a half-mile trek
(round-trip) through one of Sauk County’s most scenic
oak savannas. The trail honors the Walsh family as well as
all the families who sold their properties to make White
Mound County Park possible. Parking available at the
start of the trail.

RIDGE TRAIL
Approximately 1.90 miles (one-way)
This trail travels from the north end of the lake to the
south end through the woods of White Mound County
Park. Parking available at the boat landing or dam
parking lot.

RIDGE TRAIL
Approximately 1.90 miles (one-way)
This trail travels from the north end of the lake to the
south end through the woods of White Mound County
Park. Parking available at the boat landing or dam
parking lot.

HORSE CAMPGROUND
For those who bring their own horses, the horse camp-
ground (typically open 5/15 - 10/31) offers 7 campsites, all
with electrical and water hook-ups (2 concrete ADA). Each
campsite has a fire ring, picnic table, hitching post and
high line. The horse campground has portable toilets
located in the middle of the campground. A manure pit is
available at the west end. Day use parking is available
along the north side of the campground road.

Welcome! White Mound County Park offers a camp-
ground, with dump and water fill stations available –
weather permitting. The park also offers horse trails
and camping for those who bring their own horses.
Pets are allowed in most areas of the park, but they
need to remain on a 6 ft. leash at all times.
The park surrounds the 104-acre White Mound Lake
that many use for paddle sports, swimming, fishing
and boating at a slow-no-wake speed. Users can
access the lake via the boat landing, shoreline or via
the ADA fishing pier. Types of fish found in White
Mound Lake include panfish, largemouth bass, north-
ern pike and catfish.
Built in 2018, the Prairie Smoke Terrace overlooks
White Mound Lake, and is available as a venue to host
family reunions, weddings, graduation parties and
more. Additionally, outdoor Shelter #1 is available for
rent as well.
Trails include access for hiking, snowshoeing and
snowmobiling. Scattered around the park are many
picnic areas that include playgrounds, grills, picnic
tables, hammock stations, bathrooms and shelters.
White Mound County Park provides quality night sky
viewing – many astronomers visit the park to see the
night sky. Please contact our office for more details.
Hunting and trapping are allowed in many areas of
the park (outside of pink dotted area). No hunting
trapping allowed within 10’ of shoreline (towards
water and towards land). An accessible hunting blind
is available for use by permit for people with disabili-
ties to hunt deer and turkey.
An entrance fee is required for motorized vehicles.
Park rules and more detailed information can be
found at our website or by scanning the QR code on
the reverse side of this brochure.
